ex.note: Density set:Perform a set w/ a weight you can do for 12 to 15 reps and be 1 rep shy of failure. Repeat this load for 5min w/ the # of sets, reps & rest at your discretion. Overload 5-10lbs per week

ss.note: Keep shoulders pinned back on pad. Puff chest out. Slight bend at elbows. Move arms across chest while shoulders are pinned back. Think of trying to make inside of your elbows touch.
Stand at an angle and lean chest into pad. Align cables at or slightly below shoulder height. Protract shoulders and think of sweeping your arms to the corners of the room.

ex.note: Reduce previous set weight by 10% and perform AMRAP set until you hit 2 RIR or RPE8.
Slow and controlled reps. Step over front foot and step down. DO NOT PUSH OFF BACK LEG. Push through front leg.
Last set: 10-15% reduction in weight and AMRAP until prescribed RPE.
Use ab straps if available so grip is not the limiting factor in this exercise.
Think of "bending the bar." As you do this cue, drive your elbows down to the sides of your body and squeeze your lats at the top of the movement.

ss.note: Hit rep range and RPE target. Rest 45 seconds and hit AMRAP until you hit prescribed RPE target again. Rest another 45 seconds and then hit AMRAP until you hit prescribed RPE a second time.

ex.note: Myo Reps: Perform activation set of 15-25 reps at RPE 8. Perform repeat sets of 3-5 reps every 10 seconds until you cannot get a set of 3 reps.

ex.n: Front Foot Elevated Bulgarian Split Squat
ex.note: Put 45lb bumper plate under front foot. Perform bulgarian split squat with control. Feel deeper hip flexion on front leg- should toast your glutes and hamstrings.
Myo Reps: Perform activation set of 15-25 reps at RPE 8. Perform repeat sets of 3-5 reps every 10 seconds until you cannot get a set of 3 reps.

ss.note: Retract scapula, then drive elbows to side until they are in line with torso. Change orientation of body to make exercise more challenging. The more paralell body is to the floor, the more difficult.
Use incline bench for chest support. With shoulders protracted against the bench, sweep arms back at a 45 degree angle. Squeeze rear delts at peak contraction.
